title: BlueBlocks: Monitoring & Database Infrastructure
description:
Set up monitoring stack and database infrastructure for BlueBlocks testnet.

## Monitoring Stack
- Prometheus for metrics collection
- Grafana for dashboards and alerting
- Pre-configured datasources and dashboard provisioning

## Database (TimescaleDB)
Comprehensive schema for block indexer with hypertables for time-series data:
- blocks - Block data with height, hash, proposer
- transactions - Transaction history with status, gas
- accounts - Account balances and metadata
- contracts - Deployed contracts with code/ABI
- validators - Validator registry with stake, uptime
- events - Contract event logs
- health_records - HIPAA-compliant metadata (no PHI)
- treasury_transactions - Ethereum bridge transactions
- network_stats - Aggregated network statistics

## Features
- Continuous aggregates for hourly/daily stats
- Retention policies for data lifecycle
- Full-text search indexes
- Audit-safe constraints
